Title: Can forced awakening be played to use fast reaction

Messages.Author: Lord of Ventrue
Messages.Body:
Can forced awakening be played to use fast reaction and does the
vampire pay a blood for not blocking????

This is what happened:

A blocked B

Than after combat "A "played fast reaction with a tapped vampire. We
agreed that "A" could not play fast reaction using Forced awakening,
because there is no action happening.

The only way to play it with Forced awakening was to use it as the
action was announced. Than wait until after combat and have the other
vampire play it.

Is this correct???

Thanks,

Lord of Ventrue

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
